results.source: network log (HAR) Kane CLI recorded during the "swap-flow" run
results.fix: Remove scripts loaded from third-party CDNs, or bundle them with the app. Every script that runs on a dApp page can read and change what the user signs, so drainers are often injected this way.

results.fix: Never store private keys, seed phrases or signing secrets in localStorage or sessionStorage. Any script on the page can read them. Keep only public data, such as the wallet address, and leave signing to the wallet.
